resources.string: Choose how to connect, then create a private room or join your friends.
Use Wi-Fi or mobile data. Everyone connects to the same QuizPK server with their own login.
Same Wi-Fi or hotspot without internet. Local hosting is not available in this update.
Online rooms use the same secure connection as AI Quiz. Your personal login is never included in an invitation.
Create as a playing host or as a separate moderator. Invite up to eight contestants.
You occupy one of eight contestant seats.
You are the nonplaying moderator, separate from all eight contestant seats.
Classic online matches are available with the M4.3 backend. Moderator gameplay and Local hosting are later stages.
Enter the six-character code from your host.
You join as a contestant. The room decides the game mode; a code never grants host or moderator control.
Share privately with invited players. Each player needs their own QuizPK login.
Join my QuizPK %1$s lobby. Invite code: %2$s. Server: %3$s. Use your own QuizPK login. Lobby only; match play is coming later.
Waiting for contestants. Share the code to invite your friends.
Saving resets everyone’s readiness. Review changes if the lobby updates while you edit.
Host disconnected. Existing seats are reserved; new players and settings wait for the host to reconnect.
Leave this lobby? Your seat becomes available to another contestant.
Close this room for everyone? Its invite code will stop working.
Going Home pauses your connection. Your seat stays reserved until you leave or the room expires. Return to Multiplayer to reconnect.
This room is closed or its two-hour invitation expired. Return to rooms to create or join another lobby.
Enter the same HTTPS server used by your friends and your individual access token. Saving updates the shared connection used by AI Quiz. It does not leave your previous room.
Connect to QuizPK with your HTTPS server and personal login.
Connecting securely and recovering your room…
Connected · Lobby is up to date
Connected · Create a room or enter an invite code
Confirming your action with the server…
An action is awaiting confirmation. Retry it to confirm the result; no second room or seat will be created.
Connection lost. Any lobby shown is the last confirmed state. Reconnect to make changes.
Secure connection could not be verified. Check the HTTPS address and connection with your host.
Your login is unavailable or no longer authorized. Update your QuizPK connection.
This room already has eight contestants. Ask a contestant to leave, or join another room.
Room not found or invite expired. Check the code with your host.
Room requests are limited. Wait at least a minute; reconnection will resume automatically. Room creation limits may take longer to reset.
The lobby changed while you edited. Reconnect, review the latest settings and try again.
This server does not support these online rooms yet. Ask the host to update it.
Check your name, invite code and lobby settings.
That action is not available for your role. Reconnect to refresh the lobby.
Your login already occupies a room. Reconnect to recover that lobby.
This action is too old to retry. Reconnect to recover the authoritative lobby before trying again.
The room service is unavailable. Check your connection or ask the host to try again.
The room was closed by its host.
